title: Tags, Filters, and Smart Lists
learningGoal: Understand the difference between tags, filters, and Smart Lists and how they work together.

items.title: What are Tags?
items.description: Labels added to a contact to identify what they're connected to

items.title: Example
items.description: Webinar Attendee - tells you this contact attended a webinar

items.title: What are Filters?
items.description: Rules to search for contacts matching certain criteria

items.title: Example
items.description: Show me contacts where Tag = Webinar Attendee AND Lead Status = Hot

items.title: What are Smart Lists?
items.description: Saved filtered views you can reopen anytime

items.title: Benefit
items.description: Instead of building the same filter repeatedly, save it as a Smart List

keyPoint: Tags label people. Filters find people. Smart Lists save the search.

actionSteps.title: Review tags on contacts
actionSteps.description: Look at how contacts are labeled

actionSteps.title: Think about filters
actionSteps.description: Consider what rules you might use to find specific groups

actionSteps.title: Plan a Smart List
actionSteps.description: Think of a group you'd want to save and reuse

nextLessonTitle: Before You Build a Smart List

quizzes.explanation: Tags label individual contacts. Filters help you search for contacts matching rules. Smart Lists save those filtered views for reuse.
